test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The poet was lost in a __reverie__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"reverie"** means a state of being pleasantly lost in one's thoughts; a daydream. (स्वप्निल अवस्था)

 
 
• **Example: **She was jolted out of her** reverie** by the sound of the phone ringing.
 
 
 
• **"Reality" **refers to the state of things as they actually exist, as opposed to an idealistic or notional idea of them. (वास्तविकता)
 
 
• **Example: **After the vacation, it was hard to return to** reality **and the daily grind.
 
 

Hence, the opposite of **'reverie' **is **'reality'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Daydream **(दिन का सपना): A series of pleasant thoughts that distract one's attention from the present.

 
 
• **Example:** He often daydreams about his future success.
 
 
 
• **Trance **(उत्कट ध्यान): A half-conscious state characterized by an absence of response to external stimuli.
 
 
• **Example: **She went into a trance during the meditation session.
 
 
 
• **Fantasy** (कल्पना): The faculty or activity of imagining impossible or improbable things.
 
 
• **Example:** He lives in a world of fantasy, always imagining himself as a superhero.
 
 

53:Tc23,

The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
